resolved.title: 内存管理
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Memory Management[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Understanding memory is an important aspect of C programming. When you declare a variable using a basic data type, C automatically allocates space for the variable in an area of memory called the [b]stack[/b]. 

An int variable, for example, is typically allocated 4 bytes when declared. We know this by using the [b]sizeof[/b] operator:[code format="c" codeId="2119"]int x;
printf("%d", [b]sizeof(x)[/b]); /* output: 4 */[/code]
As another example, an array with a specified size is allocated [b]contiguous blocks[/b] of memory with each block the size for one element:[code format="c" codeId="2120"]int arr[10];
printf("%d", [b]sizeof(arr)[/b]); /* output: 40 */[/code]
So long as your program explicitly declares a basic data type or an array size, memory is automatically managed. However, you have probably already been wishing to implement a program where the array size is undecided until runtime.

[b]Dynamic memory allocation[/b] is the process of allocating and freeing memory as needed. Now you can prompt at runtime for the number of array elements and then create an array with that many elements. Dynamic memory is managed with pointers that point to newly allocated blocks of memory in an area called the [b]heap[/b].
[note]In addition to automatic memory management using the stack and dynamic memory allocation using the heap, there is [b]statically managed data[/b] in [b]main memory[/b] for variables that persist for the lifetime of the program.[/note]

resolved.title: 内存管理函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Memory Management Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]stdlib.h[/b] library includes memory management functions. 
The statement [b]#include <stdlib.h>[/b] at the top of your program gives you access to the following:

[b]malloc([i]bytes[/i])[/b] Returns a pointer to a contiguous block of memory that is of size [i]bytes[/i].
[b]
calloc([i]num_items, item_size[/i])[/b] Returns a pointer to a contiguous block of memory that has [i]num_items[/i] items, each of size [i]item_size[/i] bytes. Typically used for arrays, structures, and other derived data types. The allocated memory is initialized to 0.
[b]
realloc([i]ptr, bytes[/i])[/b] Resizes the memory pointed to by ptr to size bytes. The newly allocated memory is not initialized.
[b]
free([i]ptr[/i])[/b]  Releases the block of memory pointed to by ptr. 
[note]When you no longer need a block of allocated memory, use the function free() to make the block available to be allocated again.[/note]

content.text:
**stdlib.h**库包括内存管理函数。
在你的程序顶部的语句`#include <stdlib.h>`能够访问以下函数：

- `malloc(bytes)` 返回一个指向连续内存块的指针，该内存块的大小为bytes。

- `calloc(num_items, item_size)` 返回一个指向具有 num_items项的连续内存块的指针，每个项的大小为item_size字节。通常用于数组，结构和其他派生数据类型。分配的内存被初始化为0。

- `realloc(ptr, bytes)` 将`ptr`指向的内存大小调整为字节大小。新分配的内存未初始化。

- `free(ptr)` 释放`ptr`指向的内存块。
content.text_html:
The stdlib.h library includes memory management functions. The statement #include <stdlib.h> at the top of your program gives you access to the following:

malloc(bytes) Returns a pointer to a contiguous block of memory that is of size bytes. ** calloc(num_items, item_size)** Returns a pointer to a contiguous block of memory that has num_items items, each of size item_size bytes. Typically used for arrays, structures, and other derived data types. The allocated memory is initialized to 0. ** realloc(ptr, bytes)** Resizes the memory pointed to by ptr to size bytes. The newly allocated memory is not initialized. ** free(ptr)** Releases the block of memory pointed to by ptr.

stdlib.h库包括内存管理函数。 在你的程序顶部的语句**#include <stdlib.h>**使你能够访问以下内容。

malloc(bytes) 返回一个指向大小为bytes的连续的内存块的指针。 ** calloc(num_items, item_size)** 返回一个指向连续的内存块的指针，该内存块有num_items个项目，每个项目大小为item_size字节。通常用于数组、结构和其他派生数据类型。分配的内存被初始化为0。 ** realloc(ptr, bytes)** 将ptr所指向的内存调整到字节大小。新分配的内存不被初始化。 ** free(ptr)** 释放ptr所指向的内存块。

content.text: 当你不再需要一个分配的内存块时，使用函数`free()`释放，之后该内存块可再次分配使用。
content.text_html:
When you no longer need a block of allocated memory, use the function free() to make the block available to be allocated again.

当你不再需要一个被分配的内存块时，使用函数free()使该块可以再次被分配。
